description: Cross-validation of SW thimble periods Π^(k) (PLT path) against GB/jet real-axis closed-form integrands for k ∈ {0,1,2,3}.  Empirical certificate of A2.1+A2.2+A2.3+A2.5 of prop:sw-period-thimble-equivalence; A2.4 (real-axis = thimble sum at k = 1) is verified EMPIRICALLY only — per AGENTS.md §3b the downstream proton-mass result remains a conjecture.
caveats: A2.4 (real-axis ≡ thimble sum for the proton word) is verified empirically only.  Per AGENTS.md §3b, every block whose `uses[]` transitively cites prop:sw-period-thimble-equivalence and is downstream of A2.4 must remain a `conjecture` (e.g. conj:baryon-period-ratio).

PLT thimble integration uses the Hessian-phase normalisation from picard_lefschetz_thimble.py; only |Π^(k)|/|GB^(k)| is compared (not the absolute phase).  The global phase factor is recorded as `global_hessian_norm_factor` for downstream consumers.
